user.title: Luna Alarm
user.description: Pick the entities for each role. The system starts in **test mode**: everything is logged and notified, nothing sounds. Timings are in the options afterwards.

detection.name: Cameras and contacts
detection.description: Which sources mean what. Use the person binary sensors (or event entities) of each camera.

data_description.wake_sensors: Doorbell, garage. Open a short wake window, never alarm on their own.
data_description.visitor_sensors: Entry camera. Short visits after a wake are fine; repeated visits or no wake raise an alert.
data_description.offlimits_sensors: Garden / fence. A person here raises an alert whenever armed.
data_description.contact_sensors: Opening raises an alert in away mode. Ignored at night.
data_description.car_events: Garage camera detection event. Vehicle or person after dark → notification, never an alarm.

house.name: House
house.description: Presence, lock, building mode and the physical killswitch.

data.inside_unlock_attribute: Lock attribute that tells the unlock source
data.night_states: Building mode values that mean night
data.press_single: Event types for a single press
data.press_double: Event types for a double press
data.press_long: Event types for a long press

data_description.persons: Everyone away → away protection arms. Arrival disarms it.
data_description.lock: Locked + building mode night arms the night watch.
data_description.inside_unlock_attribute: Optional. Leave empty if your lock doesn't report it; every unlock then counts as from inside.

outputs.name: Alarm outputs
outputs.description: Never used while test mode is on.

notifications.name: Notifications and self-check
notifications.description: Where alerts go and what must be online to arm.

data_description.health_entities: Anything else that must be available to arm (e.g. eufy connectivity sensors).
data_description.battery_sensors: Below the minimum counts as a self-check problem.
